description: Building Footprints (Town of Brookline) is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Brookline GIS Information Technologies Department, Camp Dresser McKee (CDM). This map data layer represents the building footprints for the Town of Brookline, Massachusetts. This layer is from Boston Edison Company (BECo.). The original aerial photography was flown between 1990 and 1991 at 1" = 600' negative scale. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2011. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is terms recorded on the dataset page: For educational non-commercial use only. The Town of Brookline makes no claims, no representations, and no warranties, express or implied, concerning. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
